get_pre_relax_filter_config: extract pre-relaxation filtering parameters like ltol, stol, angle_tol, and npartitions from a workflow configuration dictionary
structure_to_row: convert a raw ASE JSON structure dictionary into a standardized row dict with formula, volume, CIF string, and partition ID
process_genarris_outputs_single: process Genarris JSON output files from a single conformer directory into deduplicated partitioned parquet files
process_genarris_outputs: batch process multiple Genarris output directories in parallel using SLURM job submission with deduplication and parquet export
run_process_genarris_outputs_single: run the single-directory Genarris output processor to parse structures, deduplicate, and save partitioned parquet files
